statement: The function returns a result r and r = |{nums[i] | 0 <= i < len(nums)}|, i.e., r is the number of distinct values in nums.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 30000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums) - 1, nums[i] <= nums[i+1].

statement: The function returns a result (it does not fail) for every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 30000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums) - 1, nums[i] <= nums[i+1].

statement: The function returns a result r with 1 <= r <= len(nums).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 30000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums) - 1, nums[i] <= nums[i+1].

statement: The function returns a result r with r <= 201.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 30000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums) - 1, nums[i] <= nums[i+1].

statement: The function returns a result r with r = 1.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 30000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums) - 1, nums[i] <= nums[i+1]; len(nums) = 1.

statement: The function returns a result r with r = len(nums).
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 30000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums) - 1, nums[i] < nums[i+1].

statement: The function returns a result r with r = 1 + |{i | 1 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] > nums[i-1]}|.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 30000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums) - 1, nums[i] <= nums[i+1].

statement: The function returns a result r with r = len(nums) - |{i | 1 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = nums[i-1]}|.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 30000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums) - 1, nums[i] <= nums[i+1].

statement: The function returns a result r with r = 1 + |{i | 1 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] != nums[i-1]}|.
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 30000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums) - 1, nums[i] <= nums[i+1].

statement: The function returns a result r that equals the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence of nums. (A strictly increasing subsequence is a sequence of indices i_1 < i_2 < ... < i_m with nums[i_1] < nums[i_2] < ... < nums[i_m]; its length is m. r is the maximum such m.)
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 30000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums) - 1, nums[i] <= nums[i+1].

statement: The function returns a result r. Then r = len(nums) if and only if for every i with 1 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] > nums[i-1].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 30000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums) - 1, nums[i] <= nums[i+1].

statement: The function returns a result r. Then r = 1 if and only if for every i with 1 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] = nums[i-1].
preconditions: 1 <= len(nums) <= 30000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), -100 <= nums[i] <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums) - 1, nums[i] <= nums[i+1].
